motivation: Expanded contrast TRAIN did not improve the stochastic linear/MLP head. Compare converged, explicitly L2-regularized multinomial logistic fits on the same frozen query features, without more wording or labels.
inputs: Exactly the 596 TRAIN and 80 DEV inputs from contrast-response-32. Verify all parent feature hashes and ordered payload identities. Per-row RMS normalization is unchanged. No fitting on diagnostic or context-robustness inputs.
selection: Original DEV only, by worst bilingual-category error rate, total errors, cross entropy. Freeze serialized float64 weights before opening the original diagnostic or context34 features for scoring. Nonconverged or serialization-mismatched fits cannot be selected.
verification: Recompute exported probabilities with NumPy from serialized weights; match sklearn within 1e-10. Preserve all fits and compare selected predictions to study26 and study32 without selecting on these comparisons.
diagnostics: After selection, evaluate original ten diagnostic replies and all 120 registered context34 inputs using their verified saved features. This is cached inference, not fresh encoder inference or an independent test.
